scope: Prompt, tool metadata, prompt-template and untrusted content injection boundary.
implementation_evidence: src/runtime/prompt_content_policy.js is the single runtime owner for recursive content inspection, stable finding ids, severity aggregation, data-only classification and model-visible trust-boundary construction
src/runtime/tool_result.js applies the prompt/content boundary after output DLP sanitation to every normal toolResult without changing content[0] JSON or structuredContent
the model-visible boundary contains only policy metadata, risk severity and finding ids; it never copies hostile source text and never grants promotion
_workflow/scripts/io_prompt_firewall.js is now a compatibility adapter that re-exports the runtime owner instead of maintaining duplicate classifier rules
_tests/smoke_prompt_content_policy.js covers safe, hostile, hidden-instruction, structured and content-only results and proves original data remains intact while promotion stays forbidden
src/runtime/tool_result_assertion.js makes the two-block result boundary part of connector self-test while preserving the primary JSON/structuredContent equality contract
reconciliation_evidence: tool descriptor mutation detection is already covered by the implemented capability-attestation fingerprint and tool-surface drift controls
prompts/list is an empty compatibility surface, so prompt-template source trust is currently inactive rather than an implementation blocker
the implemented output DLP boundary already labels tool output in result _meta, but current OpenAI tool-result semantics hide _meta from the model while surfacing content and structuredContent
the prompt/content boundary therefore adds a second model-visible content block instead of relying on hidden _meta or changing every tool outputSchema

instruction detection is classification rather than content censorship: matching content remains available as data so documentation, security fixtures and code examples are not destroyed by false positives

sessionless_ready_review.notes: Root spec reviewed for sessionless-ready workflow posture; stable connector route remains unchanged and sessionless activation/migration remain separate explicit operator stages. The hidden /mcp/sessionless route is a historical transition route, not the final target architecture, and it is now retired from active repo runtime and confirmed absent on live OAuth21 3008 after the controlled restart.
